title: Officially a weiner dog owner
author: awaretweeter
text: officially a weiner dog owner. Coworker said 6 month old Steve here was a bit too wild for her. We will get you dialed in Steve
blurb: Meet Steve, a 6-month-old black-and-tan doxie who was a bit too wild for his last home. Now he's sitting sweetly in his red collar, and his brand-new human promises to get him dialed in.
